design_summary: 16x16 INT8 weight-stationary systolic array implemented in SystemVerilog. Features registered horizontal activation flow, vertical partial sum propagation, parameterizable array dimensions, and standard SV signed arithmetic for MAC sign-extension.
design_notes: Uses fully synchronous reset logic for all PE sequential elements to guarantee deterministic initial states.
Sign-extension of the MAC product naturally leverages SystemVerilog's built-in signed widening assignments.
Employs 2D unpacked arrays of signals to connect generated PEs structurally, improving code readability compared to explicit indexing over large 1D bit-vectors.
Follows strict systolic tile-based pipelining: purely combinational compute paths exist only within the MAC unit, heavily isolated by input and output register stages.
unverified_assumptions: 150 MHz timing will close without deeper MAC internal pipelining; it is assumed that a single-cycle INT8 multiplier feeding a 32-bit adder meets setup times easily on Sky130.
SystemVerilog unpacked array syntax and generation block mappings will elaborate cleanly in OpenROAD/Yosys environments.
External testbench stimulus or upstream SoC hardware implements exact wavefront scheduling for correct systolic summation.
